name: Rotterdam
tagline: Bold architecture, Europe's biggest port and windmills nearby
summary: Rebuilt after the war, Rotterdam is the Netherlands' boldest modern city. See the cube houses and the arched Markthal, cross the Erasmus Bridge, look into the mirrored Depot Boijmans art store, ride a water taxi to the harbour, and cycle out to the UNESCO windmills of Kinderdijk.
seasonNote: Summer is liveliest with festivals; winter is grey and windy.
arrival: Trains from Amsterdam take 40 minutes, from Schiphol 25; Eurostar runs from London.
gettingAround: Metro, trams and water taxis; bikes are the local way.
cashTip: Cards are used everywhere, some places are card only. Tipping is a small round-up.
foodTip: Kibbeling (fried fish), stroopwafels, Surinamese and Indonesian food.
buyTip: Design pieces and Dutch cheese from the Markthal.
